questions.questionHtml: Consider a queue which supports print() function in addition to enqueue() and dequeue(). print() is a function that prints an element of the head of the queue without removing the element. Suppose the initial content of the queue is 1,2,3,4,51,2,3,4,5 where 11 is on the head. How Many number of calls to enqueue(), dequeue() or print() is required to print queue content in reverse order (output should be printed as 5,4,3,2,1)5,4,3,2,1) such that the final content of the queue should be the same as the initial content. We are not allowed to use anything else other than enqueue(), dequeue() or print() function calls.

Consider the following pseudocode of function mystery() which takes one stack orig_stack as input and modify its content using another stack calles helper_stack

  1. void mystery(orig_stack)
  2. {
  3.     Stack helper_stack;
  4.     while (!IsEmpty(orig_stack))
  5.     {
  6.         int element = pop(orig_stack);
  7.         while (!IsEmpty(helper_stack) and Top(helper_stack) < element)
  8.         {
  9.             Push(orig_stack, Pop(helper_stack));
  10.         }
  11.         Push(helper_stack, element);
  12.     }
  13.     while (!IsEmpty(helper_stack))
  14.     {
  15.         Push(orig_stack, Pop(helper_stack));
  16.     }
  17. }


Suppose the content of orig_stack initially is −1,7,0,3,−2,−1,7,0,3,−2, where −1−1 is on the top.

What will be the content of orig_stack() after the function call mystery()?
